items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I don’t think Warren lives on the fringe. Warren is right in the center of existence.

ctx.x: I had this thought earlier today when we were with Warren Bernhardt, and then thinking about what you do and what he does, and a little bit of what I do, and that we sort of live on the fringe. But I think it’s important.
I don’t think Warren lives on the fringe. Warren is right in the center of existence.
